name: focal-point-images-smart-crop
description: Focal point picker with on-the-fly focal-cropped, retina and WebP images served through Glide.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build admin/src/index.js admin/src/upload/media.js --output-path=admin/build && npm run copy-models
scripts.zip: find . -name .DS_Store -not -path './node_modules/*' -delete && dir-archiver --src . --dest ../../focal-point-images-smart-crop.zip --exclude .DS_Store vendor/intervention/gif/entrypoint.sh .git .gitignore .distignore .claude node_modules package-lock.json package.json admin/src webpack.config.js README.md
scripts.copy-models: mkdir -p admin/build/models && cp node_modules/@vladmandic/face-api/model/tiny_face_detector_model* admin/build/models/ && mv admin/build/models/tiny_face_detector_model.bin admin/build/models/tiny_face_detector_model.dat && sed -i.bak 's/tiny_face_detector_model\.bin/tiny_face_detector_model.dat/' admin/build/models/tiny_face_detector_model-weights_manifest.json && rm admin/build/models/tiny_face_detector_model-weights_manifest.json.bak

author: Studio Noon LTD
